name: Blend
positioning: The borrower-facing front end a bank puts in front of its origination system.
description: Blend provides digital application experiences for mortgage, home equity and consumer lending: guided borrower application, automated asset, income and employment verification, document collection, status tracking and loan officer tooling, integrated into the lender's origination system.
real_estate_use: The failure point in mortgage is the borrower experience: a form that asks for two years of bank statements as PDFs loses applicants to a competitor. Blend replaces that with direct connections to payroll and bank data, so verification happens in the application instead of three weeks later, and the loan officer sees a complete file sooner.
features: Guided digital mortgage and home equity applications
Automated asset, income and employment verification
Document collection with borrower status tracking
Loan officer workspace and pipeline visibility
Integration with origination systems and pricing engines

use_cases.job: Reduce application abandonment with verified data instead of document uploads
Give borrowers a live status view instead of a phone call for every update
